fr.R: Et je suis très en colère contre les nations qui se croient en sécurité. Je n’étais qu’un peu en colère contre mon peuple. Mais ces nations sont allées trop loin et elles ont rendu ses souffrances bien pires.

sw.L: Na kwa hasira kuu ninayakasirikia mataifa yanayostarehe; kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} nilikasirika kidogo [tu], lakini wao walisaidia kuleta maafa.
sw.B: Nami nimeyakasirikia sana mataifa yanayojiona salama. Niliwakasirikia watu wangu kidogo tu, lakini mataifa hayo yakaongeza maafa.
sw.R: Nami nimeyakasirikia sana mataifa yanayodhani yako salama. Niliwakasirikia watu wangu kidogo tu. Lakini mataifa hayo yalipita kiasi, yakafanya mateso yao kuwa mabaya zaidi.

vi.L: Và với cơn giận lớn, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} giận các nước đang an nhàn; vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chỉ giận [có] một chút, nhưng chúng đã góp tay vào tai họa.
vi.B: Ta rất giận các nước tự cho mình yên ổn. Ta chỉ giận dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} một chút, nhưng chúng lại làm cho tai họa thêm nặng nề.
vi.R: Ta rất giận các nước nghĩ rằng mình được an toàn. Ta chỉ giận dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} một chút thôi. Nhưng các nước ấy đã đi quá xa, làm cho dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đau khổ hơn nhiều.

ko.L: 그리고 나는 안일하게 지내는 민족들에게 크게 진노한다. 나는 [단지] 조금 진노하였으나, 그들은 재앙을 더하였다.
ko.B: 그리고 나는 태평하게 지내는 민족들에게 몹시 진노한다. 나는 내 백성에게 조금만 노하였는데, 그 민족들은 재앙을 더 크게 만들었다.
ko.R: 그리고 나는 자기들이 안전하다고 생각하는 민족들에게 몹시 화가 나 있다. 나는 내 백성에게 조금만 화를 냈다. 그런데 그 민족들은 지나치게 굴어서 내 백성의 고통을 훨씬 더 크게 만들었다.

decisions.choice: at ease: careless and complacent in their security
decisions.reason: The word can mean peaceful in a good sense (Isaiah 33:20), but it is often used of those who are proud and careless because they feel safe (Amos 6:1; Isaiah 32:9, 11). It picks up the report of verse 11: the nations are at ease while Jerusalem lies in ruins.

decisions.choice: I was angry a little: my anger with my people was limited
decisions.reason: The word can mean "a little" in amount or "for a little while" (Isaiah 54:7-8, "for a brief moment I forsook you"). Either way, the LORD's anger with his own people had a limit, and the nations went beyond it.

decisions.choice: they helped toward disaster: they made the punishment worse than God intended
alternatives: they helped to bring about evil
decisions.reason: The nations were used to punish Judah (Isaiah 10:5-7), but they did it with cruelty and pride (Isaiah 47:6; Jeremiah 50:11; Obadiah 10-14). "Helped" is ironic: they did more harm than their task required. "Disaster" is the word often used for evil in the sense of harm.

decisions.choice: with my people (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "I was angry a little"; Balanced and Readable add who the anger was against, which verses 2 and 12 make plain. Readable adds "went too far", to make the sense of "helped toward disaster" plain (m3).

decisions.choice: "mi pueblo", with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: The words "my people" are supplied at Balanced and Readable (the Hebrew says only "I was angry a little"), and the English gives them no pronoun setting; Spanish follows it.

source.text: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּֽה־אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה שַׁ֤בְתִּי לִירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ בְּֽרַחֲמִ֔ים בֵּיתִי֙ יִבָּ֣נֶה בָּ֔הּ נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וְקָ֥ו יִנָּטֶ֖ה עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore thus says Yahweh: I have returned to Jerusalem with compassion; my house will be built in it, declaration of Yahweh of hosts, and a line will be stretched over Jerusalem.

en.L: Therefore thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: I have returned to Jerusalem with compassion; {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} house will be built in it, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, and a line will be stretched over Jerusalem.'
en.B: Therefore {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says this: I have returned to Jerusalem with compassion. My house will be rebuilt in it, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, and a measuring line will be stretched out over Jerusalem.'
en.R: So this is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: I have come back to Jerusalem to show it compassion. My temple will be built there again, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies. Builders will stretch out their measuring lines over Jerusalem.'

es.L: Por tanto, así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: He vuelto a Jerusalén con compasión; {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} casa será edificada en ella, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, y el cordel será tendido sobre Jerusalén”.
es.B: Por tanto, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: He vuelto a Jerusalén con compasión. Mi casa será reconstruida en ella, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, y se tenderá un cordel de medir sobre Jerusalén”.
es.R: Así que esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: He vuelto a Jerusalén para mostrarle compasión. Mi templo será construido allí de nuevo, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos. Los constructores extenderán sus cordeles de medir sobre Jerusalén”.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Je suis revenu à Jérusalem avec compassion ; {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} maison y sera bâtie, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, et le cordeau sera tendu sur Jérusalem.”
fr.B: C’est pourquoi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Je suis revenu à Jérusalem avec compassion. Ma maison y sera rebâtie, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, et le cordeau sera tendu sur Jérusalem.”
fr.R: Voici donc ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Je suis revenu à Jérusalem pour lui montrer {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} compassion. Mon temple y sera rebâti, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. Les bâtisseurs tendront leur cordeau sur Jérusalem.”

sw.L: Kwa hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Nimeirudia Yerusalemu kwa huruma; nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} itajengwa ndani yake, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, na kamba ya kupimia itanyooshwa juu ya Yerusalemu.'
sw.B: Kwa hiyo hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Nimeirudia Yerusalemu kwa huruma. Nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} itajengwa upya ndani yake, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, na kamba ya kupimia itanyooshwa juu ya Yerusalemu.'
sw.R: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: Nimerudi Yerusalemu ili kuuhurumia. Hekalu {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} litajengwa humo tena, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. Wajenzi watanyoosha kamba zao za kupimia juu ya Yerusalemu.'

vi.L: Vậy nên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Ta đã trở lại cùng Giê-ru-sa-lem với lòng thương xót; nhà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ được xây dựng trong thành ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy, và dây đo sẽ được giăng ra trên Giê-ru-sa-lem.'
vi.B: Vì vậy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Ta đã trở lại cùng Giê-ru-sa-lem với lòng thương xót. Nhà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ được xây lại trong thành, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy, và dây đo sẽ được giăng ra trên Giê-ru-sa-lem.'
vi.R: Vì thế, đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Ta đã trở về Giê-ru-sa-lem để tỏ lòng thương xót thành ấy. Đền thờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ được xây lại tại đó, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán. Những người thợ sẽ giăng dây đo trên khắp Giê-ru-sa-lem.'

ko.L: 그러므로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 내가 긍휼을 가지고 예루살렘으로 돌아왔다. 내 집이 그 안에 세워질 것이다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 그리고 측량줄이 예루살렘 위에 쳐질 것이다.'
ko.B: 그러므로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 내가 긍휼을 품고 예루살렘으로 돌아왔다. 그 안에 내 집이 다시 세워질 것이다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 측량줄이 예루살렘 위에 펼쳐질 것이다.'
ko.R: 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 내가 예루살렘을 불쌍히 여겨 그곳으로 돌아왔다. 그곳에 내 성전이 다시 세워질 것이다. 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 건축자들이 예루살렘 위에 측량줄을 칠 것이다.'

decisions.choice: I have returned: the LORD's return is as good as done
decisions.reason: The verb is in the form for a completed act, though the rebuilding is still ahead. The LORD speaks of his decision as already carried out. It answers the call of verse 3, "return to me, and I will return to you".

decisions.choice: my house will be built: the temple then being rebuilt
decisions.reason: The work on the temple had begun again five months earlier (Haggai 1:14-15) and was finished in 515 BC (Ezra 6:15). The promise assures the builders that their work will be completed.

decisions.choice: a measuring line will be stretched out: the city will be laid out for rebuilding
decisions.reason: Builders stretched a line to mark out what was to be built (Job 38:5; Jeremiah 31:39). The same picture is used of destruction in 2 Kings 21:13 and Isaiah 34:11, but here it is for building. It looks ahead to the man with a measuring line in 2:5. The written and read forms of the word differ slightly in spelling, not in meaning.

decisions.choice: temple (R); builders (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says "temple" for "house", which is what is meant, and names the builders, since the passive verb implies them. The single quotation mark closes the message begun in verse 14.

decisions.choice: "el cordel" (L), "un cordel de medir" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The measuring line of the term sheet, which comes back with the man of 2:5. The inner quotation closes here, as in the English; the angel's words continue into verse 17.

decisions.choice: "le cordeau"
decisions.reason: The builder's line, as the term sheet sets it for Zechariah's measuring line (2:5). The inner “ ” closes here, as the English single mark does.

decisions.choice: "kamba ya kupimia"
decisions.reason: The builder's measuring line, the same words as 2:5. The single quotation mark closes the message, as in the English.

decisions.choice: "dây đo"
decisions.reason: The measuring line of 2 Kings 21:13, here used for building; the same word comes back in 2:5.

decisions.choice: "측량줄"
decisions.reason: The builder's line, the same word as 2:5; the closing formula is God's own words, so it has no honorific (거느린 at R).

source.text: ע֣וֹד׀קְרָ֣א לֵאמֹ֗ר כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת ע֛וֹד תְּפוּצֶ֥ינָה עָרַ֖י מִטּ֑וֹב וְנִחַ֨ם יְהוָ֥ה עוֹד֙ אֶת־צִיּ֔וֹן וּבָחַ֥ר ע֖וֹד בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Again proclaim, saying, Thus says Yahweh of hosts: Again will overflow my cities from good, and will comfort Yahweh again Zion, and will choose again Jerusalem.

en.L: Call out again, saying, 'Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts: My cities will again overflow with good, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will again comfort Zion and will again choose Jerusalem.'"
en.B: Proclaim this as well: '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says this: My cities will once again overflow with prosperity, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will again comfort Zion and again choose Jerusalem.'"
en.R: Announce this too: 'This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says: My towns will again be full of good things. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will comfort Zion again, and once more {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will choose Jerusalem as {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own.'"

es.L: Clama otra vez, diciendo: “Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos: Otra vez {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ciudades rebosarán de bien, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} consolará otra vez a Sion, y escogerá otra vez a Jerusalén”».
es.B: Proclama también esto: “{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos dice esto: Mis ciudades volverán a rebosar de prosperidad, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} volverá a consolar a Sion y volverá a escoger a Jerusalén”».
es.R: Anuncia también esto: “Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos: Mis ciudades estarán otra vez llenas de cosas buenas. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} consolará de nuevo a Sion, y una vez más {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} escogerá a Jerusalén como {{deity_pronoun:suya|Suya}}”».

fr.L: Crie encore, disant : “Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : Mes villes déborderont encore de bien, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} consolera encore Sion, et choisira encore Jérusalem.” »
fr.B: Proclame aussi ceci : “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées dit ceci : Mes villes regorgeront de nouveau de prospérité, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} consolera encore Sion et choisira encore Jérusalem.” »
fr.R: Annonce aussi ceci : “Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : Mes villes seront de nouveau pleines de bonnes choses. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} consolera encore Sion, et une fois de plus {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} choisira Jérusalem pour qu’elle soit à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.” »

sw.L: Piga kelele tena, ukisema, '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asema hivi: Miji {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} itafurika tena kwa mema, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataifariji tena Sayuni, na ataichagua tena Yerusalemu.'"
sw.B: Tangaza na hili pia: 'Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asemavyo: Miji {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} itafurika tena kwa fanaka, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataifariji tena Sayuni na kuichagua tena Yerusalemu.'"
sw.R: Tangaza na hili pia: 'Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi analosema: Miji {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} itajaa tena mambo mema. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataifariji Sayuni tena, na kwa mara nyingine ataichagua Yerusalemu kuwa mji {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe.'"

vi.L: Ông hãy kêu lên lần nữa rằng: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán thế này: Các thành của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lại tràn đầy phước lành, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ lại an ủi Si-ôn, và sẽ lại chọn Giê-ru-sa-lem.'"
vi.B: Ông cũng hãy công bố điều này: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán như vầy: Các thành của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lại tràn đầy thịnh vượng, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ lại an ủi Si-ôn và lại chọn Giê-ru-sa-lem.'"
vi.R: Ông cũng hãy loan báo điều này: 'Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán: Các thành của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lại đầy dẫy những điều tốt đẹp. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ an ủi Si-ôn một lần nữa, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ lại chọn Giê-ru-sa-lem làm của riêng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.'"

ko.L: 다시 외쳐 말하여라. '만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 내 성읍들이 다시 좋은 것으로 넘칠 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 다시 시온을 위로하고, 다시 예루살렘을 택할 것이다.'"
ko.B: 또 이렇게 선포하여라. '만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 내 성읍들이 다시 풍요로 넘칠 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 다시 시온을 위로하고 다시 예루살렘을 택할 것이다.'"
ko.R: 이 말씀도 전하여라. '하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 내 성읍들이 다시 좋은 것들로 가득할 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 다시 시온을 위로하고, 다시 예루살렘을 자기 것으로 택할 것이다.'"

decisions.choice: again, four times: the promise of renewal is stressed
decisions.reason: The small word for "again" or "once more" begins the verse and comes back three times in the message. Each blessing is a return of what was lost: the towns full, Zion comforted, Jerusalem chosen.

decisions.choice: overflow with good: be so full of prosperity that it spills over
decisions.reason: The verb usually means to spread out or scatter, and is used of springs that overflow (Proverbs 5:16). The towns will be so full that they spill over, a picture taken up in 2:8, where Jerusalem has too many people for walls.

decisions.choice: choose Jerusalem again: the LORD will again make it the place of his name
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy speaks of "the place the LORD your God will choose" for his name to dwell (Deuteronomy 12:5), and Jerusalem became that place (1 Kings 11:13). The exile seemed to undo the choice; the promise renews it. The same words come back in 2:16, and 3:2 calls the LORD the one "who has chosen Jerusalem".

decisions.choice: with good (L); with prosperity (B); full of good things (R); as his own (R)
decisions.reason: "Good" here means prosperity, as Balanced says. Readable adds "as his own" to say what choosing Jerusalem means. The marks close the second message and the angel's words, which began in verse 14.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 다시 시온을 위로하고 ... 택할 것이다", without -시-
decisions.reason: The LORD speaks of himself by name inside his own message, so he takes no honorific, as the term sheet sets for God's own mouth.
